title: vLLM Serving Internals: PagedAttention, Continuous Batching, Chunked Prefill

questions.question: Request.blocks_needed() uses which block size in the toy scheduler?
options: 16 tokens per KV block
32 tokens per KV block
256 tokens per KV block
512 tokens per KV block
questions.explanation: KV_BLOCK_SIZE is 16, and blocks_needed computes ceil((prompt_len + output_len) / 16).

questions.question: For a request with 1,000 prompt tokens and 25 output tokens, how many KV blocks are reserved?
questions.explanation: The total is 1,025 tokens; ceil(1,025/16) = ceil(64.0625) = 65 blocks.

questions.question: What does chunked=True change in simulate_continuous?
options: It disables continuous admission
It pads every request to the longest prompt
512-token prefill slices
It raises KV_BLOCKS_AVAILABLE to infinity
questions.explanation: The chunked path takes min(CHUNK_SIZE, remaining), with CHUNK_SIZE=512, so long prefills yield to decode work between slices.

questions.question: Why can simulate_static waste work compared with continuous batching?
options: It never runs a decode forward
It rejects all prompts longer than 16 tokens
It uses no KV blocks at all
Pads to each batch's longest request
questions.explanation: simulate_static chooses max prompt and max output for each fixed window, so shorter requests pay for padding and wait for the slowest member.

questions.question: When is Request.in_prefill true?
options: While prefilled is smaller than prompt_len
Only after generated reaches output_len
Whenever the request has a nonzero output length
Only when the KV budget is exhausted
questions.explanation: The property is self.prefilled < self.prompt_len; once all prompt tokens are processed, the scheduler enters decode.

questions.question: What is the intended effect of CONTINUOUS + CHUNKED in the demo's final comparison?
options: More padding and a higher P99 ITL
Lets decode run between prefill slices
Serial execution with no admission or release
A larger prompt cache but no scheduling change
questions.explanation: Chunked prefill bounds each prefill slice at 512 tokens, allowing active decodes to progress instead of being blocked by one long prompt.
